metadata.source: Derived from 7th Sea Core Rulebook, 7th Sea 1st Edition sourcebooks, historical pirate weaponry references, and fan resources
metadata.theme: Golden Age of Piracy - Caribbean Theater (c. 1660-1730)

items.name: Knife
items.notes: Suffers +5 TN penalty to Active Defence. Universal tool and backup weapon.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: A common secondary weapon. Easily concealed.

items.name: Stiletto
items.notes: Suffers +5 TN penalty to Active Defence. Ignores 2 points of Reduction from armor. Ideal for piercing.

items.name: Main-Gauche
items.notes: A parrying dagger, used in the off-hand for defense.

items.name: Triple-Dagger
items.notes: +5 TN to Active Defence. -5 to Attack. An unusual and tricky weapon.

items.name: Naval Dirk
items.notes: A heavy-bladed knife carried by sailors and junior officers. Part tool, part weapon.

items.name: Gully
items.notes: A large, heavy fighting knife popular among pirates. Useful for cutting rigging and close-quarters brawling.

items.name: Cutlass
items.notes: The quintessential pirate sword. Short, heavy, curved blade. Easy to draw and deadly in close quarters.

items.name: Hanger / Hunting Sword
items.notes: A short, curved sword with a single edge. A naval and military sidearm, favored by boarding parties.

items.name: Sabre
items.notes: A cavalry sword with a curved blade. Also used by naval officers.

items.name: Rapier
items.notes: A thin, thrusting blade. More common among duelists and officers than common pirates. Less handy below decks.

items.name: Smallsword
items.notes: A lighter, faster dueling sword. A status symbol among wealthy pirates and captains.

items.name: Scimitar
items.notes: A curved sword from the Crescent Empire. Rare in the Caribbean, but a prized trophy.

items.name: Broadsword
items.notes: A wide-bladed, heavy sword. Favored by those who prefer a crushing blow.

items.name: Longsword
items.notes: Suffers +5 TN penalty to Active Defence. A versatile, two-handed blade.

items.name: Claymore
items.notes: Attack Roll has -1k0 penalty. A massive Scottish two-handed sword.

items.name: Zweihander
items.notes: Must be set before attacking. An enormous two-handed sword.

items.name: Falchion
items.notes: A single-edged, cleaver-like sword. Effective at chopping.

items.name: Hatchet (Throwing)
items.notes: Can be thrown. A common tool and weapon.

items.name: Woodsman's Axe
items.notes: A utility tool and weapon.

items.name: Great Axe
items.notes: A massive two-handed axe.

items.name: Boarding Axe
items.notes: The iconic pirate boarding tool. Designed for climbing, cutting rigging, and combat. Can be used one or two-handed.

items.name: Club
items.notes: A simple, heavy bludgeon. Often a belaying pin, easily found on any ship.

items.name: Mace
items.notes: A metal-headed club. Effective against armor.

items.name: Flail
items.notes: A spiked ball on a chain. Unpredictable and dangerous.

items.name: Spear
items.notes: A versatile polearm. Common on ships as a boarding pike.

items.name: Boarding Pike
items.notes: A long spear used to repel boarders or push enemies back during a boarding action.

items.name: Lance
items.notes: Off horseback damage is 1k2. Using without a Move Action increases TN by +5 (horseback) or +10 (foot). Shatters if inflicts >30 Wounds.

items.name: Halberd
items.notes: An axe-bladed polearm.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.notes: A simple wooden staff.

items.name: Harpoon
items.notes: A thrown spear with a barbed head, often with a rope attached. Used for whaling and as a weapon.

items.name: Whip
items.notes: Doubles an opponent's bonus to Armor TN from armor.

items.name: Improvised Weapon
items.notes: A chair, bottle, or other object. Anything can be a weapon in a pirate brawl.

items.name: Brawling
items.notes: Fighting with fists, feet, and improvised techniques.

items.name: Avalon Longbow
items.notes: Requires Brawn 4. -1k0 for every 50ft past Range. +10 TN if used from horseback.

items.name: Cossack Bow
items.notes: Requires Brawn 3. -1k0 for every 50ft past Range. +10 TN if used on foot.

items.name: Standard Bow
items.notes: Requires Brawn 2. -1k0 for every 50ft past Range. +10 TN if used from horseback.

items.name: Crossbow
items.notes: Slow to reload but powerful. Sometimes used by sharpshooters in the rigging.

items.name: Throwing Knife
items.notes: Can be thrown. A common pirate ranged weapon.

items.name: Bola
items.notes: Used to entangle a target. Rare in the Caribbean, but used by some South American natives.

items.name: Flintlock Pistol
items.notes: Damage Modified by Wits. Ignores all Reduction. -1k1 for every 20ft past Range. Ignores armor bonuses. 1 shot, 2 rounds to reload.

items.name: Flintlock Pistol (Queen Anne)
items.notes: A smaller, more easily concealed pistol. Popular with pirates for its compact size. 1 shot, 2 rounds to reload.

items.name: Flintlock Pistol (Sea Service)
items.notes: A heavier, more powerful naval pistol. Standard issue for ship's officers. 1 shot, 2 rounds to reload.

items.name: Flintlock Pistol (Duckfoot)
items.notes: A multi-barreled pistol with splayed barrels. Fires a spread of shot. Difficult to aim, devastating at point-blank range.

items.name: Brace of Pistols
items.notes: Two pistols. Some pirates carry up to three braces (6 pistols). Allows two shots before reloading.

items.name: Musket
items.notes: Damage Modified by Wits. Ignores all Reduction. -1k1 for every 20ft past Range. Ignores armor bonuses. Often used by sharpshooters from the rigging.

items.name: Blunderbuss
items.notes: A short, wide-barreled firearm that fires a spread of shot. Devastating at close range, especially during boarding actions.

items.name: Arquebus
items.notes: An early, heavy firearm. Less common in the Caribbean during the Golden Age.

items.name: Musketoon
items.notes: A short-barreled musket. Favored by cavalry and boarding parties for its handiness.

items.name: Grenado (Grenade)
items.notes: A cast-iron sphere filled with gunpowder and a fuse. Dangerous to both wielder and target. Area of effect.

items.name: Stinkpot
items.notes: A pottery jar filled with sulfur, pitch, and other foul materials. Creates a cloud of noxious smoke. Non-lethal, but can cause panic and confusion.

items.name: Firepot
items.notes: A clay pot filled with flammable liquid and a fuse. Used to set enemy ships on fire.

items.name: Powder Flask (Explosive)
items.notes: A horn or metal flask of gunpowder with a fuse. Makeshift grenade. Risky to carry and use.

items.name: Petard
items.notes: A small bomb used to blow open doors or gates. Sometimes used in boarding actions to breach bulkheads.

items.name: Cannon (Shipboard)
items.notes: Ship-mounted artillery. Fires round shot, grapeshot, or chain shot. Devastating against ships and crews.

items.name: Buckler
items.notes: +5 Armor TN against Non-Ranged Attacks.

items.name: Full Shield
items.notes: +10 Armor TN against Non-Ranged Attacks.

items.name: Cloak
items.notes: Used for defense and distraction.

items.name: Panzerhand
items.notes: An Eisen gauntlet used for parrying and bashing.

items.name: Lantern Shield
items.notes: A small shield with a built-in lantern. Can be used to blind opponents. +5 Armor TN.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.notes: A hooked iron tool on a rope. Can be used to snag enemies, rigging, or to climb. Can be thrown.

items.name: Padded Armor
items.notes: A thick, padded coat. Common among sailors for protection against splinters.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.notes: Boiled or hardened leather. Offers some protection against cuts.

items.name: Buff Coat
items.notes: A heavy leather coat. Worn by cavalry and some pirates. Offers good protection against sword cuts.

items.name: Quilted Jacket
items.notes: A padded, quilted garment. Worn under mail or alone. Comfortable in the Caribbean heat.

items.name: Chainmail
items.notes: Interlocking iron rings. Offers good protection but is heavy and hot.

items.name: Cuirass
items.notes: A breastplate, often worn over mail or a padded jack. Common among officers.

items.name: Brigandine
items.notes: A jacket with small iron plates riveted between layers of fabric. Popular with pirates for its flexibility.

items.name: Lamellar Armor
items.notes: Small rectangular plates laced together. Rare in the Caribbean, but used by some Spanish conquistadors.

items.name: Half-Plate
items.notes: Partial plate armor covering the torso and limbs. Heavy and restrictive, but offers excellent protection.

items.name: Full Plate
items.notes: Complete plate armor. Rare in the Caribbean due to heat and cost. Offers the best protection.

items.name: Leather Cap
items.notes: A simple leather skullcap. Offers minimal head protection.

items.name: Morion
items.notes: A steel helmet with a brim and crest. Worn by Spanish soldiers. Offers good protection.

items.name: Cabasset
items.notes: A steel helmet with a brim. Similar to the morion, but with a different shape.

items.name: Seaman's Hat (Tarred)
items.notes: A wide-brimmed hat stiffened with tar. Offers some protection from the sun and rain.

items.name: Lantern
items.notes: An oil lantern with a metal frame. Essential for below decks and night operations.

items.name: Candle
items.notes: A simple wax candle.

items.name: Torch
items.notes: A burning brand of wood and pitch.

items.name: Rope (50ft)
items.notes: Hemp rope. Essential for sailing and climbing.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.notes: An iron hook for climbing and boarding.

items.name: Lockpicks
items.notes: Tools for picking locks. Useful for breaking into strongboxes.

items.name: Crowbar
items.notes: An iron bar for prying open chests and doors.

items.name: Compass
items.notes: A navigational aid. Essential for sea travel.

items.name: Spyglass
items.notes: A telescope for spotting ships and land.

items.name: Map (Caribbean Chart)
items.notes: A map of the Caribbean. Cost depends on detail and accuracy. Priceless to a pirate captain.

items.name: Disguise Kit
items.notes: Costumes and makeup for disguise. Useful for blending in at port.

items.name: Medical Kit (Surgeon's Kit)
items.notes: Bandages, salves, saws, and tools for treating wounds. Essential for any ship.

items.name: Powder Horn
items.notes: A horn or metal flask for carrying gunpowder. Essential for firearms.

items.name: Shot Pouch
items.notes: A leather pouch for carrying musket balls and shot.

items.name: Manacles
items.notes: Iron shackles for prisoners. Common on slave ships and pirate vessels.

items.name: Pouch
items.notes: A small leather bag for carrying coins or items.

items.name: Backpack (Sea Bag)
items.notes: A canvas bag for carrying gear. Common among sailors.

items.name: Waterskin
items.notes: A leather flask for carrying water. Essential for long voyages.

items.name: Rowboat / Longboat
items.notes: A small boat for rivers and coastal waters. Used for shore parties and boarding actions.

items.name: Sloop
items.notes: A single-masted sailing vessel. Fast and agile. Favored by pirates for its speed.

items.name: Brigantine
items.notes: A two-masted vessel. A common pirate ship, balancing speed and cargo capacity.

items.name: Galleon
items.notes: A large, multi-masted ship. Used for treasure fleets and naval engagements.

items.name: Riding Horse
items.notes: A reliable horse for travel. Useful for overland expeditions in the Caribbean.

items.name: Warhorse
items.notes: A trained horse for combat. Rare in the Caribbean.

items.name: Mule
items.notes: A sturdy pack animal. Essential for overland travel with supplies.

items.name: Donkey
items.notes: A smaller, more stubborn pack animal. Common in the Caribbean.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Common Pirate
npc_equipment_sets.description: A typical member of a pirate crew.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Boarding Party
npc_equipment_sets.description: A pirate specialized in boarding actions.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Pirate Captain
npc_equipment_sets.description: A successful and well-equipped pirate captain.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Sharpshooter
npc_equipment_sets.description: A pirate skilled with firearms, often stationed in the rigging.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Spanish Soldier
npc_equipment_sets.description: A soldier of the Spanish Empire, stationed in the Caribbean.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Buccaneer
npc_equipment_sets.description: A hunter and pirate of the Caribbean, often of French origin.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Voodoo Pirate
npc_equipment_sets.description: A pirate with ties to the mystical traditions of the Caribbean.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Pirate Brute
npc_equipment_sets.description: A large, intimidating pirate focused on heavy combat.

npc_equipment_sets.name: Shipboard Cannoneer
npc_equipment_sets.description: A pirate skilled in operating shipboard artillery.
